newsitem.title: UK: Groupama restructures Sorema reinsurance unit.
newsitem.headline: Groupama restructures Sorema reinsurance unit.

text.p: French insurance mutual Groupama is to restructure its reinsurance holding company Sorema International in a bid to increase synergies between the two operations.

Groupama plans to hand over management of its entire reinsurance activities to Alexis Ruset, currently chairman and chief executive officer of Caisse Centrale de Reassurance, who will join Groupama as chairman and chief executive officer of Sorema International.

Sorema International owns Paris-based reinsurer Sorema, which in turn owns Sorema (UK) and 90% of Sorema N.A. Reinsurance Co., the North American affiliate based in New York. Sorema also has branches in Canada and Singapore and offices in Cologne, Germany, and Mexico.

Gilles Laporte, deputy managing director of Groupama, will give up his title of chief executive officer, but ill remain as chairman of Sorema International to represent shareholders and ensure continuity of the group's reinsurance operations, according to a company statement.

"This reorganization underlines the objective which we stated in 1996 of developing our reinsurance presence on the basis of our strengths - namely, one of the best solvency positions in the market allied with a high level of expertise, particularly in facultative reinsurance," said Laporte in the statement.
In the first nine months of 1996, Sorema N.A. had net premiums written of $111 million and policyholders' surplus of $165 million.
